targets.approach: The Mummy is a granite pinnacle low in Mummy Canyon, near where the canyon opens into Pinnacle Valley beneath the southwest ridge of the Needle. From the North Crest Trail take the Chimney Canyon Trail from the junction just north of the radio towers, go down its switchbacks through the limestone band, then leave the trail westward and head straight downhill to an aspen meadow and a clearing that ends at a cliff overlooking the canyon. Drop through the steep forest east of the overlook into the untrailed canyon, continue until aspens give way to scree, and pick a way down the boulder-strewn talus with the pinnacle in sight. The start is a shallow chimney in the tower's southeast corner.
targets.descent_text: Descent is a rappel down the south face along the line of ascent, from anchors on the summit.
targets.name: Route 1

targets.approach: Climb the slope from the upper end of the Lobo ski run to where the Raven ski run finishes, close by. The route is on the rock outcrop there: go to the center of the outcrop, beneath the slight bulge near its top, where a crack lies to the right.
targets.name: Knight Moves

targets.approach: The route is on the west side of East Sentinel, the lesser formation just before the Sentinel. Stand on the saddle between the Sentinel and East Sentinel and look east: the deep crack and chimney on the wall in front of you is the start.
targets.descent_text: The back side of the formation is a walk-off.
targets.name: Osa
